description: Precedence (ADR 0026 §2; the 0002 lead's order: limits and shape, then base64url of protected headers and signatures, then protected-header JSON, then the payload's base64url under the effective b64, then header structure, then steps 5–9): a compact JWS whose protected header has no alg (header structure) and whose payload is padded (payload base64url) fails with the base64url code
